evals.prompt: research youtube on computational screening of single-atom catalysts, i want the parts where they discuss stability
evals.expected_output: search-*.json from yt_search.py, 1-3 picked videos shown with reason, transcripts fetched, locate windows, report-*.md with a timestamped-parts table using clickable youtu.be?t= links

assertions.name: all three stages run as scripts (search/transcript/locate), no inline python
search + locate outputs are valid JSON files in workspace
every report timestamp equals some window start_s (no invented timestamps)
report states search source (google_api or yt_dlp) and any fallbacks

evals.prompt: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XXXXXXX where does it explain the free energy diagram? give me timestamps
evals.expected_output: transcript fetched for the given ID, locate run with keywords like 'free energy diagram', table of relevant parts with MM:SS + clickable links, irrelevant windows dropped by judgment

assertions.name: video ID extracted correctly from URL
each reported link's t= equals its window start_s
irrelevant keyword windows filtered out with stated reasons

evals.prompt: find 5 recent youtube videos (last 6 months, must have captions) about battery electrolyte degradation and tell me which is most relevant for a beginner
evals.expected_output: yt_search.py run with --months 6 --require-captions --max-results 5, captions_filter_applied true (or fallback disclosed), relevance ranking for a beginner audience with justification

assertions.name: search ran with months + captions filters
if source is yt_dlp, api_error reason is disclosed to user
one video picked as beginner-appropriate with explicit reasoning
